items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: She sang one or two tunes with us that night.

ctx.x: And I listened to that kind of things. And in the meantime I had a gig after hours right across the street there, what was it called, I don’t know but anyway it was a little after- hours joint. We played from maybe two to five in the morning. You know, I mean that type of thing. And one night Billie Holiday walks in. And she sits down on the side there with her little dog, a Chihuahua I think it was. And so put my hand out like this, and the dog grabbed me. She says, “honey don’t do that,” she says, “always do…

thing. It was during the Boston years. And the Boston thing just went on for a while and then my night gig ran out after a year. But I was making $50 a week. And all the other guys says, “well that’s a poor paying club” they says, “the guy didn’t pay you too much money.” But to me—
